title: Alternative Smithing Table Recipe
description: Provides an alternative recipe to the Smithing Table ...for whatever reason
body:
Changes the recipe for the Smithing Table (while also making it slightly more expensive)

This mod is for any modpack author too lazy to use KubeJS. However, this mod can also act as a bug-fix to address [Hot Iron](https://modrinth.com/mod/hot-iron/versions)'s broken recipe for the Smithing Table. 

Compatible with JEI/REI/EMI.
